note: Words for the long-press tooltips (roadmap 13.49, Suleiman 13 Nov). Hold a finger on a button or a fighter for half a second. 'holdMs' is how long the hold is. 'buttons' explains the main buttons; a skill's own text comes from spells.json and an item's from items.json. 'statuses' explains each status word shown over a fighter (the key is the word; a number after it, like BLOODIED 2, is dropped).

buttons.Move: Walk up to your Move in tiles. You can act first and walk after, or walk, act, and use the steps you have left.
buttons.Undo move: Step back to where you stood, as long as you have not acted.
buttons.Attack: Strike a foe in reach. Attacks from behind or on a foe busy in a clash hit more often.
buttons.Engage: Lock a foe next to you in a clash. Each turn you both pick a stance: Guard beats Press, Press beats Slip, Slip beats Guard. Win 3 steps of momentum to throw them Off-Balance.
buttons.Verses: Blessings for allies and hexes for foes. They cost MP.
buttons.Items: Use something from the bag on yourself or an ally next to you, or dig up what is buried close by. It takes your action.
buttons.End turn: Finish this fighter's turn. Unused Poise comes back while you stay out of clashes.
buttons.Press: Attack hard. Uses Power. Beats Slip, loses to Guard. A win moves momentum 2.
buttons.Guard: Hold firm. Uses Guard. Beats Press, loses to Slip.
buttons.Slip: Dodge and counter. Uses Agility. Beats Guard, loses to Press.
buttons.Break away: Try to get out of the clash. Uses Agility. Easier against Guard, harder against Press.
buttons.Empower: Spend 1 Poise for +3 on your next stance.
buttons.Fight: The game picks the stance that suits this fighter and what the foe did last.

statuses.ENGAGED: Locked in a clash. It cannot walk away or use skills until the clash ends.
statuses.OFF-BAL: Off-Balance: thrown in a clash. Easier to hit and weaker in the next clash, until its next turn ends.
statuses.EXPOSED: Exposed: lower defence and evade while it rests.
statuses.BLOODIED: Bloodied Press: each stack takes 1 off every hit while it fights in Press.
statuses.CHARGE: Counter-Press: stored blows. Losing a beat releases them as a counter-punch.
statuses.BULWARK: Bulwark: each level pushes it 1 tile less.
statuses.HIDDEN: Hidden: foes cannot target it. A blast that covers its tile still hits and reveals it.
statuses.MEDITATING: In a trance: it cannot act on its next turn, then MP comes back.
statuses.AIMING: Aiming a Poison Arrow: it flies next turn unless the aim is broken.
statuses.MARKED: An archer is aiming at this fighter. Break her aim or step out of her line.
statuses.POISON: Poisoned: loses health at the start of each of its turns. Bitter leaf or Herbs cure it.
statuses.BURN: Burning: loses health at the start of each of its turns. Water or Bitter leaf puts it out.
statuses.ENCHANTED: Enchanted weapon: its hits burn for extra damage.
statuses.ROOTED: Rooted: standing its ground. It cannot be pushed.
statuses.STUNNED: Stunned: it loses its next turn.
statuses.DISORIENTED: Disoriented: slammed into something. Its next attack is likelier to miss.
statuses.BLINDED: Blinded by smoke: it cannot take aim at range.
statuses.DRENCHED: Drenched: lightning hurts it more, fire less.
statuses.ECHO: Echo ready: the decoy will copy the next spell.
statuses.PRESS: Its last stance in the clash: Press.
statuses.GUARD: Its last stance in the clash: Guard.
statuses.SLIP: Its last stance in the clash: Slip.
